simulation.name: IBM Finance Department - Agentic AI Transformation
simulation.description: End-to-end simulation of IBM's Finance Department transformation through LLM-powered agentic AI, covering 9 finance domains across 175 countries over a 24-month phased rollout.

accounts_payable.name: Accounts Payable
accounts_payable.description: End-to-end procure-to-pay processing including invoice receipt, matching, approval, and payment execution across all IBM legal entities.

agents.name: Invoice Intake Agent
agents.role: Receives, classifies, and extracts data from incoming invoices across all channels (email, EDI, portal, mail) using multi-modal LLM processing.

agents.name: Three-Way Match Agent
agents.role: Performs automated three-way matching between purchase orders, goods receipts, and invoices with tolerance-based exception handling.

agents.name: Invoice Approval Router
agents.role: Routes invoices through appropriate approval chains based on amount, category, cost center, and policy with intelligent escalation.

agents.name: Payment Execution Agent
agents.role: Optimizes payment timing, selects payment methods, executes payment runs, and manages early payment discount opportunities.

agents.name: AP Fraud Detection Agent
agents.role: Monitors all AP transactions for fraud indicators including duplicate invoices, vendor impersonation, payment diversion, and billing schemes.

accounts_receivable.name: Accounts Receivable
accounts_receivable.description: Order-to-cash processing including billing, collections, cash application, credit management, and dispute resolution across all revenue streams.

agents.name: Billing Generation Agent
agents.role: Generates invoices from contracts, usage data, and milestones with multi-currency, multi-entity, and revenue recognition compliance.

agents.name: Cash Application Agent
agents.role: Automatically matches incoming payments to open invoices using AI-powered remittance parsing and fuzzy matching algorithms.

agents.name: Collections Intelligence Agent
agents.role: Manages collection strategies using AI-driven customer segmentation, payment prediction, and personalized outreach optimization.

agents.name: Credit Risk Assessment Agent
agents.role: Evaluates customer creditworthiness using financial data, payment history, market signals, and predictive models for credit limit decisions.

agents.name: Dispute Resolution Agent
agents.role: Manages customer billing disputes through automated investigation, root cause analysis, and resolution recommendation.

general_ledger.name: General Ledger & Close
general_ledger.description: Financial close management including journal entries, intercompany reconciliation, consolidation, and reporting across 320 legal entities.

agents.name: Journal Entry Agent
agents.role: Automates recurring, accrual, and adjusting journal entries with intelligent posting logic and variance explanations.

agents.name: Account Reconciliation Agent
agents.role: Performs automated account reconciliations with intelligent matching, variance identification, and certification workflows.

agents.name: Consolidation Agent
agents.role: Automates multi-entity consolidation including currency translation, elimination entries, minority interest, and equity method adjustments.

agents.name: Close Orchestration Agent
agents.role: Manages the end-to-end financial close process across all entities with task tracking, dependency management, and bottleneck identification.

fp_and_a.name: Financial Planning & Analysis
fp_and_a.description: Budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, strategic planning, and management reporting providing actionable financial intelligence.

agents.name: Forecasting Intelligence Agent
agents.role: Generates revenue, expense, and cash flow forecasts using ML models, macroeconomic indicators, pipeline data, and historical patterns.

agents.name: Variance Analysis Agent
agents.role: Performs automated variance analysis comparing actuals to budget and forecast with natural language explanations and root cause identification.

agents.name: Management Reporting Agent
agents.role: Generates automated management reports, board decks, and executive dashboards with AI-generated narratives and insights.

agents.name: Strategic Planning Agent
agents.role: Supports long-range planning, M&A analysis, market sizing, competitive intelligence, and investment decision modeling.

treasury.name: Treasury & Cash Management
treasury.description: Global cash management, liquidity planning, FX risk management, debt management, and bank relationship coordination.

agents.name: Cash Position Agent
agents.role: Provides real-time global cash visibility, automated cash positioning, and intraday liquidity management across 850 bank accounts.

agents.name: FX Risk Management Agent
agents.role: Monitors FX exposures, executes hedging strategies, and optimizes currency positions across 85 functional currencies.

agents.name: Debt Management Agent
agents.role: Manages debt portfolio, covenant monitoring, interest rate risk, and capital markets intelligence for IBM's $56B debt portfolio.

agents.name: Cash Forecasting Agent
agents.role: Generates daily, weekly, and monthly cash flow forecasts using AI models incorporating AR/AP patterns, payroll, and market conditions.

tax.name: Tax Compliance & Planning
tax.description: Global tax compliance, transfer pricing, tax provision, indirect tax, and tax planning across 175 jurisdictions.

agents.name: Tax Provision Agent
agents.role: Automates quarterly and annual tax provision calculations including ASC 740, deferred tax analysis, and ETR forecasting.

agents.name: Tax Compliance Agent
agents.role: Manages tax return preparation, review workflows, filing deadlines, and regulatory change monitoring across all jurisdictions.

agents.name: Transfer Pricing Agent
agents.role: Monitors intercompany transactions for arm's length compliance, prepares documentation, and optimizes transfer pricing structures.

agents.name: Indirect Tax Agent
agents.role: Manages VAT/GST determination, compliance, and recovery optimization across global transactions.

internal_audit.name: Internal Audit
internal_audit.description: Risk-based internal auditing, SOX compliance testing, continuous monitoring, and control assurance across all finance operations.

agents.name: Continuous Monitoring Agent
agents.role: Performs real-time transaction monitoring, pattern detection, and control testing across all finance processes using 3,200+ automated rules.

agents.name: Audit Planning Agent
agents.role: Develops risk-based audit plans using AI-driven risk assessment, resource optimization, and coverage analysis.

agents.name: Audit Execution Agent
agents.role: Performs automated audit procedures including data analytics, sampling, testing, and evidence gathering with AI-assisted workpaper preparation.

agents.name: SOX Compliance Agent
agents.role: Manages SOX 404 testing lifecycle including control identification, test plan execution, deficiency evaluation, and remediation tracking.

compliance.name: Regulatory Compliance
compliance.description: Financial regulatory compliance including SEC reporting, sanctions screening, anti-money laundering, and policy enforcement.

agents.name: SEC Reporting Agent
agents.role: Automates SEC filing preparation including 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and proxy statements with XBRL tagging and cross-reference validation.

agents.name: Sanctions & AML Screening Agent
agents.role: Performs real-time sanctions screening, AML transaction monitoring, and KYC/KYB verification across all customer and vendor transactions.

agents.name: Regulatory Change Agent
agents.role: Monitors regulatory changes across 175 jurisdictions, assesses impact, and coordinates implementation of compliance requirements.

agents.name: Policy Enforcement Agent
agents.role: Monitors compliance with internal finance policies, manages attestation workflows, and identifies policy violations.

procurement.name: Procurement & Sourcing
procurement.description: Strategic sourcing, vendor management, contract lifecycle management, and purchase-to-pay optimization.

agents.name: Strategic Sourcing Agent
agents.role: Performs spend analysis, market intelligence, supplier evaluation, and optimal sourcing strategy recommendation.

agents.name: Contract Lifecycle Agent
agents.role: Manages contract creation, negotiation support, obligation tracking, and renewal management with AI-powered clause analysis.

agents.name: Purchase Order Agent
agents.role: Automates PO creation, approval routing, change management, and compliance checking with budget validation.

agents.name: Supplier Management Agent
agents.role: Manages supplier onboarding, performance monitoring, risk assessment, and relationship optimization across 67,000 suppliers.

claude-opus-4-2026.use_case: Complex reasoning, strategic analysis, regulatory interpretation

level_2.description: Create and route, no financial commitment

level_3.description: Process and approve within defined thresholds

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Deploy AP and AR automation targeting highest-volume, quickest-ROI processes. Establish integration infrastructure and agent governance framework.

milestones.milestone: Infrastructure deployment and SAP integration testing
milestones.success_criteria: API connectivity to SAP S/4HANA with <100ms latency

milestones.milestone: AP invoice intake agent production pilot (Budapest SSC)
AP three-way matching and fraud detection live
AR cash application agent production pilot
AP and AR agents scaled to all SSCs
Full AP/AR automation with continuous learning
milestones.success_criteria: 65% AP automation, 60% AR automation, measurable FTE reduction

risks.mitigation: Parallel development of direct database and API integration paths

risks.risk: Data quality issues in invoice extraction
risks.mitigation: Human-in-the-loop validation with continuous model fine-tuning
Change management program, reskilling commitments, and phased transition

phases.name: Core Expansion
phases.description: Extend automation to GL close processes, FP&A intelligence, and Procurement. Target month-end close acceleration and forecast accuracy improvement.

milestones.milestone: GL journal entry and reconciliation agents deployed
Consolidation agent live for top 50 entities
FP&A forecasting agent in production
Procurement PO and sourcing agents deployed
Accelerated close achieved (5-day close)
All core domains operational with cross-domain orchestration

risks.risk: Month-end close process interdependencies cause cascading delays
risks.mitigation: Phased close task automation with parallel human processing
Ensemble model approach with human analyst override capability

risks.risk: Procurement agent conflicts with existing sourcing tools
risks.mitigation: Integration-first approach, augment rather than replace existing tools

phases.name: Advanced Capabilities
phases.description: Deploy Treasury, Tax, and Audit automation. These domains require highest accuracy, regulatory compliance, and sophisticated decision-making.

milestones.milestone: Treasury cash positioning and forecasting agents live
milestones.success_criteria: Real-time cash visibility across 90%+ of bank accounts

milestones.milestone: FX risk management automation operational
Tax provision agent deployed for quarterly close
milestones.success_criteria: Provision calculation in <48 hours with <1% variance

milestones.milestone: Continuous audit monitoring fully operational
milestones.success_criteria: 3200+ automated monitoring rules active with <5% false positive rate

milestones.milestone: Transfer pricing automation live
milestones.success_criteria: Automated arm's length testing for 90%+ of IC transactions

milestones.milestone: All advanced domains operational with cross-domain intelligence

risks.risk: Regulatory scrutiny of AI-driven tax decisions
risks.mitigation: Human-in-the-loop for all tax positions, comprehensive audit trails

risks.risk: Treasury agent errors causing financial loss
risks.mitigation: Simulation-first deployment, strict limits, dual-control for large transactions

risks.risk: Audit independence concerns with AI-driven audit
risks.mitigation: AI augments auditors rather than replaces, maintains professional judgment requirement

phases.name: Enterprise Transformation
phases.description: Full integration across all 9 domains with autonomous operations, continuous learning, and predictive intelligence. Compliance domain added as final domain.

milestones.milestone: Compliance agents (SEC, sanctions, regulatory) deployed
milestones.success_criteria: Automated SEC filing preparation with XBRL

milestones.milestone: Cross-domain intelligence layer operational
milestones.success_criteria: Agents share context and coordinate across all 9 domains

milestones.milestone: Predictive analytics driving proactive decisions
milestones.success_criteria: AI-initiated recommendations adopted >60% of the time

milestones.milestone: Autonomous close process (2-day virtual close)
Full continuous learning and self-optimization
milestones.success_criteria: Agent performance improving quarter-over-quarter without manual tuning

milestones.milestone: Enterprise transformation complete
milestones.success_criteria: All KPIs at or above target, total cost savings >$500M annualized run-rate

risks.risk: Over-reliance on AI leads to skill atrophy in finance team
risks.mitigation: Mandatory human competency maintenance program, rotation through manual processes

risks.risk: Systemic AI failure during critical period (quarter-end close)
risks.mitigation: Documented manual fallback procedures, tested quarterly, 4-hour recovery SLA

risks.risk: AI decisions challenged by regulators or auditors
risks.mitigation: Complete explainability framework, decision audit trails, regulatory engagement program

strategic_risks.name: LLM Model Degradation
strategic_risks.description: AI model updates or provider changes degrade agent performance, causing processing errors or delays.
mitigation_strategies: Multi-model architecture with automatic failover
Continuous model performance monitoring with regression testing
Model version pinning with controlled rollout
On-premises model deployment option for critical workflows

strategic_risks.name: AI Regulatory Compliance
strategic_risks.description: New AI regulations (EU AI Act, SEC AI guidance) impose constraints on AI use in financial decision-making.
mitigation_strategies: Proactive regulatory engagement and lobbying
Explainability framework for all agent decisions
Human-in-the-loop architecture for high-impact decisions
Regular AI ethics and compliance assessments

strategic_risks.name: Systemic Agent Failure
strategic_risks.description: Cascading failure across multiple agents during critical processing period (quarter-end close, tax filing deadline).
mitigation_strategies: Circuit breaker patterns with automatic graceful degradation
Documented manual fallback procedures for all critical processes
Quarterly disaster recovery testing
Geographic redundancy for agent infrastructure
4-hour recovery time objective for critical agents

strategic_risks.name: AI-Targeted Attack
strategic_risks.description: Adversarial attacks targeting AI agents including prompt injection, data poisoning, or model extraction.
mitigation_strategies: Input validation and sanitization for all agent inputs
Prompt injection detection and prevention layers
Data provenance tracking and integrity verification
Red team exercises targeting AI systems quarterly
Zero-trust architecture for agent-to-system communications

strategic_risks.name: ROI Underperformance
strategic_risks.description: Transformation fails to deliver projected cost savings due to higher-than-expected AI operating costs or lower automation rates.
mitigation_strategies: Phased investment with gate reviews at each phase
Conservative baseline assumptions with upside scenarios
Monthly ROI tracking with early warning indicators
Vendor cost optimization through multi-provider strategy

strategic_risks.name: Talent Retention and Morale
strategic_risks.description: Key finance talent leaves due to AI transformation concerns, or workforce morale degrades affecting productivity.
mitigation_strategies: Transparent communication about transformation impact
Reskilling investment ($25M budget) for affected employees
AI Operations career path with competitive compensation
Retention bonuses for critical-path employees during transition
Employee AI advisory council with direct leadership access

strategic_risks.name: Data Quality and Integrity
strategic_risks.description: Poor data quality in source systems propagates through AI agents causing incorrect financial reporting or decisions.
mitigation_strategies: Data quality scoring at every integration point
Automated data validation rules with rejection thresholds
Source system data cleansing program pre-deployment
Data lineage tracking for audit trail compliance
Reconciliation checkpoints between agent processing stages

strategic_risks.name: AI Provider Dependency
strategic_risks.description: Over-reliance on single AI provider creates risk of service disruption, pricing changes, or capability regression.
mitigation_strategies: Multi-provider architecture supporting model switching
Contractual protections including SLA guarantees and price caps
Open-source model fallback capability for critical workflows
Regular provider diversification assessment

steering_committee.decision_authority: Investment approval >$5M, policy changes, risk acceptance

ai_center_of_excellence.reporting_to: CFO with dotted line to CTO

domain_ai_champions.description: One per domain, responsible for agent configuration, performance, and business alignment

ethics_framework.bias_testing: Monthly automated bias testing on all agent decisions
ethics_framework.explainability_requirement: All financial decisions must have human-readable explanation

change_management.communication_cadence: Weekly updates, monthly town halls, quarterly all-hands
change_management.resistance_management: Anonymous feedback channel, change champions network, early adopter recognition
